label: Whole-set modal necessitation: JointNecessitation requires truth of ALL members of each admitted…
definition: JointNecessitation requires truth of ALL members of each admitted candidate at an accessible world to imply truth of its same target there. It imposes no individual-member sufficiency. All relevant enabling conditions must be included for the complete-ground interpretation; whether they are included or the policy applies to real explanation remains open.
note: Analyst framework for #545, not independently established metaphysical applicability. See docs/notes/grounding-baseline-545.md for examples, exclusions, structural properties and strongest rival replies.
